en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a canal or river flowing between old multi‑story buildings, with balconies and arcades along the right bank and trees and houses on the left. A low stone bridge crosses the water in the middle distance, and a church tower with a pointed roof rises behind the buildings. At the bottom center margin, printed in red and black, is the caption 'Borgo - Lungo il Brenta'.
